items.question: What work does the Calder & Wynne engagement cover?
items.answer:
The Calder & Wynne engagement letter does not specify the exact nature of the work covered by the engagement. The documents provided only mention that the engagement involves legal services, as it refers to "this engagement" in the context of termination and liability clauses.

The engagement letter includes a clause allowing either party to terminate the engagement at any time with written notice, and the client will pay for work done up to the termination point [2].

Additionally, the engagement limits Calder & Wynne's liability to GBP 5 million [3].

evidence.quote: Either of us may end this engagement at any time by written notice. You will pay our fees for work done up to that point.
Our aggregate liability to you in connection with this engagement is limited to GBP 5 million.

items.question: Is the service credit cap set per month or per year?
items.answer:
The documents indicate that the service credit cap is set per calendar month. Specifically, the service credit cap is stated as "twenty-five percent (25%) of the monthly subscription fee for that month" [1].

Additionally, the monthly subscription fee is specified as USD 18,500 [2]. This confirms that the cap is calculated based on the monthly subscription fee, not an annual amount.

evidence.quote: Service credits in any calendar month are capped at twenty-five percent (25%) of the monthly subscription fee for that month.
Client shall pay a platform subscription fee of USD 18,500 per month for the Harrowgate platform.

items.question: Who should Voss-Lindqvist direct questions about the change of control to?
items.answer:
The documents indicate that Voss-Lindqvist should direct questions about the change of control to Harrowgate Systems Inc.'s General Counsel.

The Change of Control Notice states, "Please direct any questions to our General Counsel, Thomas Reyes," and it is signed by Thomas Reyes, General Counsel, for Harrowgate Systems Inc. [1].

evidence.quote: Please direct any questions to our General Counsel, Thomas Reyes.

items.question: Where are the MSA's service levels set out?
items.answer:
The MSA's service levels are set out in Schedule 2 of the Master Services Agreement.

This is stated in the MSA, which provides: "Provider shall provide the Services in accordance with the service levels in Schedule 2" [1].

evidence.quote: Provider shall provide the Services in accordance with the service levels in Schedule 2

items.question: How many years does the warehouse lease run for?
items.answer: The warehouse lease runs for ten (10) years, starting on 1 April 2025 and ending on 31 March 2035 [3].

evidence.quote: The term is ten (10) years starting on 1 April 2025 and ending on 31 March 2035 (the "Term")

items.question: At which facility does Kestrel store Voss-Lindqvist's equipment?
items.answer: The documents indicate that Kestrel stores Voss-Lindqvist's equipment at the Brookfield facility. This is stated in the Storage Services Agreement between Voss-Lindqvist AB and Kestrel Cold Storage Ltd [1].

evidence.quote: Provider will store Client's archived equipment at its Brookfield facility.
